product_overview: DeelRxCRM is a mobile-first CRM, POS, and inventory management system designed specifically for regulated, inventory-driven small businesses emphasizing financial accuracy, inventory traceability, role-based accountability, and auditability.
core_goals: Ensure financial accuracy with immutable transaction records and rigorous audit logs.
Maintain inventory traceability with immutable historical data and logged adjustments.
Implement strict role-based accountability with server-side enforced permissions.
Optimize operational speed on mobile devices for rapid transaction processing.
Support regulatory compliance and auditability with detailed logs and immutable data.
key_features: Mobile-optimized Point of Sale (POS) supporting fractional quantities, price overrides with role validation, and tax configuration.
Robust Inventory Management tracking quantities, weights, costs per unit, with immutable historical intake and adjustment records.
Deterministic Pricing and Tax Logic with configurable tax rules per business and explicit rounding rules.
Customer Relationship Management (CRM) with flexible customer creation, purchase history aggregation, and soft-disable only for customers.
Comprehensive Reporting and Auditability including sales, inventory movement, tax summaries, user actions, and append-only audit logs.
Role-based access control with defined permissions for Cashier, Supervisor, Manager, and Super Admin enforced at the database level.
AI-powered Credit Engine for credit limits and analysis integrated with the core system.
user_flow_summary: Cashier logs into the system and executes sales using the POS interface optimized for mobile one-hand operation.
Supervisor can perform sales with the ability to override prices within limits, void transactions, and adjust inventory with audit logging.
Manager accesses expanded controls to manage products, pricing, tax settings, customers, suppliers, and generate reports and analytics.
Super Admin manages all system users, permissions, business settings, and views audit logs and system diagnostics.
All users interact with immutable transaction and inventory records ensuring no silent data mutation.
Customer profiles are accessed and managed with purchase histories and notes; customers are soft-disabled rather than deleted.
validation_criteria: No silent mutations of financial or inventory data—data must be immutable or append-only.
All sensitive actions (price overrides, inventory adjustments, voids/refunds, permission changes) must generate immutable audit logs.
Role-based permission enforcement must occur server-side and at the database level with no reliance on UI controls.
Mobile POS must be usable with one hand and allow new staff to complete a sale within two minutes.
Historical data must remain trustworthy and unaltered after entry.
Tax and pricing calculations must follow deterministic, reproducible, and transparent rounding rules.
No use of mock data in production environments.
